newsitem.title: USA: U.S. urges Americans in Pakistan to mind security.
newsitem.headline: U.S. urges Americans in Pakistan to mind security.

text.p: The State Department on Friday urged U.S. citizens in Pakistan to be careful about their personal security because of what it said was a continuing threat of anti-American violence.

"The Department believes that persons with a history of violence and anti-Americanism may still be planning unspecified violence against U.S. interests in Pakistan," said a statement, which followed an earlier warning Aug. 15.

It advised Americans to vary their movements, to look out for surveillance, unusual phone calls, unexpected visitors or packages and abnormal incidents, to inspect vehicles for signs of tampering and to park in secure, well-lit areas.
